Method of Attack: Encrypts all files on each host in the network using strong encryption algorithm
Targets organizations by hacking into Remote Desktop Services connected to the Internet
Traverses through the network to encrypt every accessible computer
Deletes or encrypts backups or formats backup disks
Drops ransom notes with .readme_txt appended to encrypted files
Attack Vector: Hacking into Remote Desktop Services connected to the Internet
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom notes stating 'Your network has been penetrated' and 'All files on each host in the network have been encrypted with a strong algorythm'
Ransom notes named as encrypted files with .readme_txt appended (e.g., test.jpg.readme_txt)
Ransom note text including BTC wallet and contact emails
